name: world_bank_procurement-mcp
description: World Bank Procurement Notices (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documente

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /api/v2/procnotices?format=json with the World Bank Search API conventions documented on the API page: qterm (full-text query), rows (page size, default 10) and os (0-based record offset). The procnotices collection itself has no dedicated reference page (confidence medium); fields are from the live response: id, notice_type, noticedate (DD-Mon-YYYY), notice_status, project_ctry_name, project_id, project_name, bid_reference_no, bid_description, procurement_method_name, submission_date, notice_text (HTML). total is a string in the response, so total is null. buyer is the financed project's name; contract awards are included (notice_type). Some notices carry no bid_description; their title falls back to project_name (live check 2026-09-26).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Same collection filtered by id (e.g. OP00470638).
